heading: FAQ’s on Health & Fitness App Development Solutions

items.question: Can the app sync with wearables?
items.answer: Yes. Integration with popular wearables and health platforms is available.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on customisation.

items.question: Can trainers upload their own plans?
items.answer: Yes. Trainers can create plans and host sessions.

items.question: Does it support subscriptions?
items.answer: Yes. Subscription plans and in-app payments are supported.

items.question: Can I add live classes?
items.answer: Yes. Live and recorded classes can be included.

items.question: How much does a fitness app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on features and integrations. Share your requirements for an estimate.
